# mv: rename a struct field
mv T.X T.Y
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct {
	X int
}

func F(t T) int { return t.X }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 package m

 type T struct {
-	X int
+	Y int
 }

-func F(t T) int { return t.X }
+func F(t T) int { return t.Y }
